name: AOBP Integration
description: Records an AOBP blood pressure measurement from a Uscom BP+ device directly into a REDCap survey, using the BP+ JavaScript SDK.

authors.name: Oliver Stanesby
authors.institution: Menzies Institute for Medical Research, University of Tasmania

project-settings.name:
Instrument that carries the AOBP controls
The unique instrument name, not its label. Blank uses aobp_visit.

Instrument that uses the collapsible information panels
Blank uses info.

Set the device clock from this computer when it is out by more than this many minutes
Blank uses 5. The measurement timestamp comes from the device, so a wrong clock mislabels data permanently.

Show warnings from attempts the device recovered from
The BP+ retries a determination it could not measure and reports the discarded attempt even when a later one succeeded — so a good reading arrives carrying a warning nobody can act on. Off by default: the alerts are recorded either way, and reporting them trains an operator to ignore the panel.

Store the raw measurement XML as a file on the record
Needs File Upload fields named seated_raw_xml and standing_raw_xml. A full result runs past 100 kB, which no text field will hold, so this is where the XML belongs.

Log every serial line to the browser console
Troubleshooting only.

TESTING ONLY — simulated BP+
Takes measurements from a built-in simulator instead of a real device, so the survey, the file storage and the record can be tested with no BP+ and no cable. Readings are fabricated. The page says so in a red banner, and every record is written with a device id beginning SIMULATED-. Never enable this on a project collecting real data.
